item.title: Apple Launches Home View Hub, TV 4K & iPhone Duo
item.description: Apple’s ‘Welcome Home’ launch adds a $299 Home View hub, a revamped Apple TV 4K, a $149 HomePod mini 2, and a chaotic iPhone Duo pre‑order rush globally.

item.title: Apple TV 4K & HomePod mini Ship Oct 30 with A19 & S10
item.description: Apple confirms Apple TV 4K with an A19 chip and HomePod mini with an S10 chip will ship on October 30, after the Oct 13 “Welcome Home” event.
